engineering_defaults_notice: Batch size, topK, block size, audit fraction, split seed, metadata-neighbor depth and Bernoulli probability are provisional cost/discovery/audit parameters. They are not scientific quality guarantees, final counts, pair quotas, labeling budgets or owner-approved acceptance thresholds.
approved_semantics: Topic > Event > Story; Event is broader parent, Story is a supported strand.
All supported memberships are equal. No primary/secondary ranking.
Specific occurrences and duplicate coverage are distinct from hierarchy identity.
Shared-only-some coverage is partial overlap, not whole-article duplication.
Additional detail does not automatically create a Story; a shared Topic does not imply a shared Event.
Article-to-article neighbors only; no reader-query dataset.
Every frozen article must eventually be annotated or explicitly reasoned unresolved.
Primary labels are model gpt-6.1-sol, not human or prior Qwen labels.
Read full stored summaries first; consult original sources when ambiguous/conflicting; required inaccessible evidence remains unresolved.
Independent targeted review plus reproducible random audit; not mandatory second pass of all labels.
Generic names and majority vote cannot automatically reconcile catalog identities.
Representative probability sample and targeted challenge streams are separately reported.
B1-B10 approved meanings only; B10 proposed explanatory sibling Story is still flagged, not adjudicated.
Fresh development/confirmation event groups; the old 935 binary regression frame is immutable and not new hierarchy gold.
No production adoption, fine-tuning, public action or publication approval.
stages: freeze exact approved bytes and regression hashes
register saved vector provenance and report text conflicts/missing coverage
export blind bounded primary evidence batches
import model submissions atomically as unresolved/catalog-pending/qualified
explicitly review shared identity proposals and aliases
export independent blind targeted/random audit batches; join answers after import
acquire archive-wide probability and metadata candidates plus per-model rank union
independently judge pair evidence, including occurrence and coverage
fix event/article partitions before tuning; quarantine newly crossing components
freeze development-only algorithm settings before confirmation predictions
measure only complete declared qrels and overlapping memberships; report blockers honestly
append local delta commits; never publish without owner approval
